Owner evidence to composed current view
Pinned transport to eligible Windows effect
Provider identity metadata to custody and consumer scope

environments.name: Nonexecuting source review
environments.required: Connected exact GitHub/file reads; no executable imports
environments.forbidden: No tests, mailbox requests or machine side effects

environments.name: Isolated offline owner tests
environments.required: Complete source, trusted checker and actual fixed workload/isolation
environments.forbidden: No inherited provider secrets, production sockets or writable control state

environments.name: Native Linux and PostgreSQL
environments.required: Owner-admitted OS/socket/systemd/database requirements and independent limits
environments.forbidden: No mocked kernel or substitute database credited as native proof

environments.name: Native Windows and local DC
environments.required: Current Paths ER033/034 and EN545 actor/effect/target route
environments.forbidden: Fixed probe does not authorize arbitrary shell or a Linux suite

environments.name: Installed observe-only
environments.required: Exact installed artifact/config/current owner and admitted observer
environments.forbidden: No source-fixture pass promoted to runtime proof

environments.name: Bounded natural operation
environments.required: Actual useful task, event limits, original-effect recovery and target readback
environments.forbidden: No fake CI storm or unselected activation

environments.name: Isolated restore and retirement
environments.required: Owner selected checkpoint/candidate, disposable target, rollback and cadence
environments.forbidden: No production deletion or reboot from an audit design

journeys.name: Bounded read-only objective
journeys.outcome: An admitted read returns the correct target result without a target mutation.
journeys.entry_boundary: Actual callable ingress and fixed owner action; request/result correlation; target readback.
journeys.prerequisite: Current narrow route and admitted observation
closure_requirements: actual named ingress through independent observable result
no substituted boundary credited beyond its scope
